name: Leum
overview: Leum is a male figure mentioned in the book of Genesis as the son of Dedan. Beyond this lineage, Scripture does not provide additional details regarding his tribe or other distinguishing notes. His identity is primarily anchored in his paternal connection to Dedan.
namesAndTitles: The name Leum appears as a proper name in Genesis 25:3. There is no recorded meaning or special title associated with this name in the biblical text.
familyAndRelationships: Leum is explicitly identified as the son of Dedan. Scripture does not record any further family relationships or descendants related to Leum beyond this paternal link.
scriptureSignificance: Leum's significance in the biblical narrative is tied to his place within the genealogical records of Genesis. As a son of Dedan, he forms part of the ancestral lineage that traces the descendants of Abraham, contributing to the broader understanding of Israel's extended family tree and God's providential plan through generations.
